Users work inside applications such as Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where the assistant can summarize meetings and email, draft documents, surface answers from existing files and conversations, and help employees move from context gathering to action without switching tools. solution_components.role: Grounds prompts in Microsoft 365 content so employees can summarize meetings and email, draft documents, and retrieve answers without leaving daily workflows.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Coordinates cases, service interactions, and end-user requests on a unified CRM platform.

data_flow: Employee prompts entered in Microsoft 365 apps are grounded in the user’s permitted files, conversations, and meeting context, then returned in the same workflow as summaries, drafts, or answers that staff can act on immediately.
